text: At night the cemetery is quiet enough to hear a shovel stop. No child is among these graves. Which witness or clue will you pursue?

options.label: Ask Agatha what the lichguard is meant to do
Watch Agatha work and write down what you see
Use one carried dose to protect a fresh grave
Bring the grave abuse to Father Naskew without drawing steel
Leave the graves undisturbed and keep a private note
